capabilities: display bookmarked notes prominently in the file explorer
style the bookmarked-files pane via the .prominent-decorated-file CSS class
disambiguation: Not a starring or favoriting tool; it highlights notes saved in the core Bookmarks plugin.
extras: Documentation has moved to an external site. The plugin is in maintenance mode: pull requests and bug reports are reviewed, but feature requests are not being worked; the author states this is not permanent. Requires the Files and Bookmarks core plugins to be enabled. Previously known as Prominent Starred Files.
intentEvidence: this plugin requires the Bookmarks Core Plugin also be enabled
problem: Bookmarked notes are hard to spot among other files in Obsidian's file explorer.
summary: File explorer decoration that prominently displays notes bookmarked with the core Bookmarks plugin.
